description: blocks-rarity-rolls: the rarityRolls section: schema (no item, a source that is none of craft, loot, give, a rarity that is none, a misspelt field), KL406 for a rule that rolls crafts (its default sources, or "craft") of an item of this mod with a recipe, by block name or by a pattern over this mod's items ("loot, give" and other mods' items are not warned); the mod says clients kiln for its new items.

diagnostics.message: rarity roll "crafted" rolls crafts of "ember-sword", which has a recipe: the recipe tooltip shows the item's own rarity while a craft comes out at a rolled one; leave "craft" out of "sources" to keep crafts as the tooltip says

rarity roll "own-pattern" rolls crafts of "ember-sword" (and 1 more), which has a recipe: the recipe tooltip shows the item's own rarity while a craft comes out at a rolled one; leave "craft" out of "sources" to keep crafts as the tooltip says
an empty list: give at least one entry
"crafting" does not have the expected form (^(craft|loot|give)(, ?(craft|loot|give))*$)
"mythic" is not allowed here (allowed: common, epic, legendary, rare, uncommon)
"chance" is not allowed here (allowed: items, sources, weights)
